action_tendency.x_profile_rule: R17 (2026-10-18): profile membership is derived from the comparability class, not chosen. Essential = every affective field classed "comparable" (run-1 pass on populated answers, or run-2 pass, and - for the 19 comparable-tier fields tested across vendors in run 3 - holding the market rule under R18 reading (b), R19-R28); Extended = Essential + "interpretive" + "null-driven"; Full = all 47; partner profiles select freely from their base. Field class = class of the lead unit (LEAD_UNIT); sub-members ride with their field. Computed in scripts/v09_layout.py (COMPARABILITY, PROFILES_09); nothing hand-listed.
